summary: Master anti-bribery and corruption risk management with practical tools, ISO 37001:2016, due diligence, and reporting templates. Enrol today.
lede: Anti-bribery and corruption training helps compliance, procurement, audit, finance, legal, and governance professionals identify and manage bribery exposure. It covers risk scoring, third-party due diligence, transaction reviews, proportionate control design, and investigation escalation. Participants practise building risk registers and action plans, documenting cases, and reporting progress through management information and board dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to identify, manage, and report bribery and corruption risks in daily operations. It is especially relevant for people who sit at the intersection of compliance, procurement, audit, finance, legal, and governance, where weak controls or unclear escalation can create material exposure.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workbook exercises, plus access to a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. If your organization uses an internal compliance register, gifts and hospitality log, or third-party due diligence template, you can use those as reference inputs during the workshops.
